title: Three Years and a Hill
subtitle: 优势与竞争 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 优势与竞争（做人与做事·竞争与优势）
meta: 主题语境：优势与竞争（做人与做事·竞争与优势）　|　核心词汇：advantage　|　正文 356 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 advantage 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1973 my uncle had one ① advantage in the town, which was that he had been born three years before the other man, and he said being born first is the only advantage you cannot lose. He ② had an advantage over everybody on the hill, meaning the shop was higher up, and he said the hill was worth three hundred pounds a year and nobody believed him.

He ③ took advantage of the rain in 1976, when the road below flooded and everybody came up the hill, and my grandmother said there was no sin in that. What she did call a sin was ④ taking advantage of his brother in 1979, who signed a paper he could not read, and she said the two uses of the word are as far apart as the two shops; an advantage, she said, is a thing you use, and a person is not a thing.

It was ⑤ to his advantage that the council put the bus stop at the top in 1981, and he said nothing about it for nine years, which my father said was the cleverest thing he ever did. The ⑥ advantage of the hill, which he had counted as three hundred pounds, turned out to be forty-one pounds a year and six steps, and he never once said he had been wrong; the advantage, he said, is never the one you counted.

By 1984 the other man had the ⑦ advantage of a telephone, and my uncle said the telephone was a machine for losing arguments at a distance. There was ⑧ no advantage at all in being first any more, and he said being first is only an advantage while there is still something to be first at, and every advantage, he said, has a date on it.

The  advantage I would count, if I were counting, is the three years and not the hill, the rain or the telephone. An  advantage, he told me in 1990, is the only thing in a life that is measured against somebody else, and the advantage is never yours alone, which is why it is the first thing people lie about.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 优势；有利条件
C. n. 有利局面；优势地位
D. 固定搭配：have / gain an advantage over ... 优于……；胜过
E. 固定搭配：take advantage of sth. 利用某事物
F. 固定搭配：take advantage of sb. 利用／占……的便宜
G. 固定搭配：to one's advantage 对某人有利
H. 固定搭配：an advantage of ... ……的一个好处

items.q: took advantage of the rain in 1976
taking advantage of his brother in 1979
to his advantage that the council
There was no advantage at all

answers.why: advantage 意为“优势、有利条件”，1973 年叔叔在镇上有一项优势：他比另一个人早生三年。
have an advantage over ... 意为“优于、胜过”，铺子在坡上，他说这让他胜过所有人。
take advantage of sth. 意为“利用某事物”，1976 年他利用那场雨：下边的路淹了，人人往坡上走。
take advantage of sb. 意为“占某人的便宜”，1979 年他利用了自己兄弟，让他在看不懂的文件上签字。
to one's advantage 意为“对某人有利”，1981 年议会把车站设在坡顶，这对他有利。
an advantage of ... 意为“……的一个好处”，这坡的好处最后算出来是每年四十一个英镑和六级台阶。
advantage 意为“好处、益处”，到 1984 年另一个人有了电话这项好处。
advantage 意为“有利局面、优势地位”，到那时抢先已毫无优势可言。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1973 年我叔叔在镇上有一项优势：他比另一个人早出生三年。（advantage）
他的铺子在坡上，比所有人都占优势，他说这坡每年值三百英镑。（have an advantage over）
1976 年他利用了那场雨：下边的路淹了，人人都往坡上走。（take advantage of）
1979 年他占了自己兄弟的便宜，让他在一份看不懂的文件上签了字。（take advantage of）
1981 年议会把车站设在坡顶，这对他有利。（to one's advantage）
他说，优势是人生中唯一要靠跟别人相比才存在的东西。（advantage）
answers: In 1973 my uncle had one advantage in the town: he had been born three years before the other man.
His shop was higher up the hill, and he had an advantage over everybody on it.
He took advantage of the rain in 1976, when the road below flooded and everybody came up the hill.
In 1979 he took advantage of his brother, who signed a paper he could not read.
It was to his advantage that the council put the bus stop at the top in 1981.
An advantage, he said, is the only thing in a life that is measured against somebody else.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 advantage 的 3 种不同用法；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1973 my uncle had one advantage in the town, and he had an advantage over everybody on the hill.
He took advantage of the rain in 1976, and my grandmother said there was no sin in that.
What she called a sin was taking advantage of his brother in 1979, who signed a paper he could not read.
It was to his advantage that the council put the bus stop at the top in 1981.
By 1984 the other man had the advantage of a telephone, and there was no advantage at all in being first.
An advantage, he told me in 1990, is the only thing in a life that is measured against somebody else.
